visual_beat: Storm rocks red buoy, Marin abandons exposed lower platform and reaches toward upper frame, orange raft whips alongside lower ladder. Sparse stylized rain, white skin stays unshaded.
text: On day twenty-five, a storm makes the buoy swing so hard that you cannot stay on the platform.

prompt:
Very simple flat 2D maritime survival cartoon. Crisp black outlines, matte solid colours, sparse shallow backgrounds and few large readable props. No photorealism, deep perspective, cinematic realism, elaborate textures or gradients on faces. Human has a perfectly round oversized PURE WHITE head, tiny black oval eyes and small line mouth, no hair, ears, nose, eyebrows or face shading. Thin BLACK stick torso and limbs, WHITE mitten hands and WHITE oval feet. One navy-blue short-brim fisherman cap. Life jacket worn by default, EXCEPT when removed and held in this shot; the exact bound variant overrides costume for this shot. No scarf, bandage or backpack. Compact stick figure matching the approved line-body reference proportions. Adults, not babies. One named individual appears once. Sea creatures have bold simple silhouettes and their own dark teal or desaturated purple colours, huge compared with the small boat, scary through scale and partial visibility rather than gore. Palette: pale dusty blue/cream by day, desaturated navy/teal at night, yellow hero accent. One continuous landscape 16:9 film frame, no words, borders or panels.
DRAWING CONSISTENCY LOCK: The approved DAYLIGHT ROPE scene is the single canonical drawing-language guide. Match its clean outlined 2D shapes, simple face, navy cap shape, yellow vest panels/buckle, pure white face/hands/feet, black stick anatomy and head-to-body proportions in every shot. Changes of action, camera or environment never authorize changing the character design or illustration technique. Night and underwater descriptions change the environment palette only; the character stays flat pure white with the same navy/yellow clothes. No oval/profile/beaked face, extra anatomy, thicker limbs, glossy shading, bloom, rim light, painterly texture, 3D lighting, chibi redesign or realistic rendering. Use two tiny black eyes and a short simple mouth, no drawn human features. Keep a readable front or three-quarter round head when the face is visible. Sea creatures use the same outlined flat illustration language, simple threatening shapes, not goofy smiling faces. Background coherence and drawing consistency are independent; free backgrounds still keep this same drawing language.

VISIBLE NAMED CAST ONLY: Marin. Each named individual appears exactly ONCE. No duplicate protagonist, memory portrait, transparent character or face pasted over a scene. Only humans have white circle heads; sea creatures retain their bound animal design.
CONTINUITY CORRECTION: The BLUE waterproof supply bag and wooden oar are already SECURED TO THE UPPER steel buoy frame with a short visible tie. They stay high on buoy as Marin climbs during the storm. The orange raft whipping against the lower ladder has an EMPTY GREY FLOOR: NO bag, oar, supplies or second Marin inside raft. Night rain changes surrounding colours only, Marin remains pure white round head/hands/feet and black stick limbs.
